items.title: 61428_Red Callender oral history interview
items.q: Nat formed a trio with Wesley Prince, who I understand just passed away recently

ctx.x: pretty rough during some of that period. I remember we used to go by and share pots of ham hocks and beans, and they were so good... [LAUGHS] And then Nat formed a trio with Wesley Prince, who I understand just passed away recently, and Oscar Moore, who was... Oscar has quit playing, too. I don't know why. He was such a beautiful player.
But anyhow, I don't know how we got off into that.
